description: This file defines the interface for URL parsing functions used within the Lighttpd server project. It declares functions for parsing raw URLs, raw paths, and hostnames, which operate on 'liRequestUri' structures.

methods.name: li_parse_raw_url
methods.description: Parses the raw URL string into its components within the 'liRequestUri' structure.

methods.name: li_parse_raw_path
methods.description: Parses and decodes the path from input, updating 'liRequestUri' with path, raw_path, and query components.

methods.name: li_parse_hostname
methods.description: Extracts and parses the hostname component of the URL into 'liRequestUri'.
